title: Five equivalent descriptions of quasi-projective morphisms over a base with an ample invertible sheaf
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For S carrying an ample invertible sheaf and f : X -> S, the lemma lists equivalent conditions: quasi-projective, H-quasi-projective, open immersion with projective closure over S, finite type with X carrying an ample invertible sheaf, and finite type with an f-very ample invertible sheaf. The retained proof is written with one constructed middle paragraph — from the projective-closure description it extracts a quasi-compact immersion into affine-space-projective via the H-quasi-projective-to-open-H-projective lemma, pulls back O(1) to get an f-very ample line bundle, and upgrades to f-ample using finite presentation and quasi-compactness (Morphisms, lemma-ample-very-ample) — while the remaining implications (2 implies 1, 1 implies 2, 2 implies 3, 4 implies 2, 5 implies 4, and the 1-equivalent-to-5 pair) are each discharged by explicit named Morphisms-chapter lemmas whose hypotheses are verified in place. Retained author proof at lines 13856-13889.
